items.definition:
a cone-shaped device used to amplify the voice
The protestor shouted through a megaphone.

a metric unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter.
The gap was only a few millimetres wide.

a motor-assisted pedal cycle.
He rode his moped to work every day.

a cinema with several separate screens.
We decided to watch the movie at the new multiplex.

a crisp, tart apple, typically with a yellowish skin.
She baked an apple pie using pippin apples.

a book of blank pages for sketching
She always carries a sketchbook to draw new ideas.

sourdough (type of bread)
I love the tangy taste of fresh sourdough bread.

stepdaughter
My stepdaughter is coming to visit next weekend.

a device for cutting or shaping
He used the hedge trimmer to neaten the bushes.

a plumbing fixture for urination
The men's restroom had two stalls and a urinal.

a man who serves drinks at a bar
The barman quickly mixed our cocktails.

goodbye (informal British English) or a type of breakfast cereal
"Cheerio, see you tomorrow!" she called out.

girl (Spanish, used informally in English)
Hey, chica, how are you doing today?

a small natural indentation in the flesh on a part of the human body, especially the cheek or chin
She had a charming dimple on her left cheek when she smiled.

the quality of being kind, tender, or mild
She handled the newborn baby with great gentleness.

a particular skill of making decorative objects by hand
The market was full of beautiful local handicraft.

the part of a coat or jacket folded back on either side of the front opening
He wore a flower on his lapel.

short for linoleum
The kitchen floor was covered in old lino.

A traditional Japanese seasoning.
She ordered a bowl of miso soup.

A long, warm coat worn over other clothes.
He put on his overcoat before going out into the cold.

A popular garden flower.
She planted colorful pansies in the window box.

the area immediately surrounding a boxing or wrestling ring
We had ringside seats for the boxing match.

a lazy, untidy person
He's such a slob; his room is always a mess.

a small tool used for picking up small objects
She used a tweezer to remove the splinter.

the branch of a nation's armed services that conducts military operations in the air.
My cousin joined the air force last year.

punctuation mark or figure of speech
The apostrophe in 'it's' indicates a contraction of 'it is'.

a man who is getting married
The bridegroom looked nervous before the ceremony.

a substance used to add flavor to food
Ketchup is a popular condiment for fries.

a person who cries easily or complains a lot
Don't be such a crybaby; it's just a scratch.

a heavy disk thrown in an athletic contest
He trained hard for the discus throw event.

a plant with large, colorful flowers
The garden was full of beautiful hibiscus flowers.

the process of creating or becoming
The new policy is still in the making.

the side or slope of a mountain
The hikers carefully ascended the steep mountainside.

the northern part of a town or area
They live on the northside of the city, near the park.

a warm jacket with a hood
She zipped up her parka to protect herself from the cold wind.

a small green nut
She enjoyed eating pistachio ice cream.

the tough outer layer of certain fruits, cheeses, or meats
You can grate the lemon rind for extra flavor.

the part of a city or town alongside a river
They enjoyed a walk along the riverfront.

a bud of a rose
The rosebud slowly began to open in the morning sun.

a tool or device used for scraping
She used a paint scraper to remove the old wallpaper.

video blog
She posts a new vlog every week about her travels.

a narrow passage or street
We walked down the dark alleyway to reach the back entrance.

a piece of cloth, typically square, worn on the head or around the neck
He tied a red bandana around his head.

a rigid bracelet or anklet
She wore several silver bangles on her wrist.

small pieces of dried bread
Roll the chicken in breadcrumbs before frying.

an arrangement to share private transportation
We organized a carpool to save on gas.

a musical percussion instrument
The drummer hit the cymbal with a loud crash.

a device, such as a button or zipper, that fastens things together
The zipper is a common type of fastener on clothing.

A secluded place.
They found a perfect hideaway in the mountains for their vacation.

A place where junk is collected and stored.
He found some old car parts at the junkyard.

a person who operates a machine, especially a machine tool
The machinist carefully operated the lathe.

a covered opening in a road or pavement, leading to a sewer or other underground pipe
Workers lifted the manhole cover to access the pipes below.

a plant of the daisy family, typically with yellow, orange, or copper-brown flowers
She planted bright orange marigolds in her garden.

a small bus, typically seating 10 to 16 passengers
The team traveled to the game in a minibus.

a carnivorous freshwater fish
Be careful swimming in that river; there might be piranhas.

a cat (often used affectionately); a gentle or timid person
My grandmother's pussycat loves to nap all day.

a male teacher in a school
The old schoolmaster was strict but fair.

the score of a game or match
The final scoreline was 3-1 to the home team.

a person who searches for something
The searcher found the lost keys under the couch.

motorized vehicle for snow
We rented a snowmobile to explore the snowy trails.

a panel in a car roof that can be opened
She opened the sunroof to let in some fresh air.

strong, narrow fabric woven in strips
The backpack straps were made of durable nylon webbing.

a bad person, especially in a story or film
In the movie, the baddie always wore a black hat.

a musical instrument with a bag and pipes
The sound of the bagpipes echoed across the valley.
